name: Disguise Mastery (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 4

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick can create a disguise in half the time normally required. In addition, any penalties from assuming a disguise of a different gender, race, age, or size are reduced by 1. This reduction stacks.
